rules: no hard cut unless cut_justification is filled (D64); shot boundaries are camera moves along a leading line
a move has hold, anticipation, action, settle like an actor; drawn layer on twos during a move, light continuous
one emitter at a time; a hand-off between emitters is a lag-chain event, not a second emitter
the muse runs per object from object_inventory, never inside the chain
